title: hardhooks config
description: hardhooks configuration (.hardhooks.json or the user-level config.json).

preset.description: `standard` (default): Guards, format-on-edit and session-context on. `strict`: every Hook on, Guards tightened.

hooks.description: Per-Hook overrides: `enabled` plus that Hook's options. Anything left out comes from the Preset.

format-on-edit.description: Formats each file the Host edits or writes with the project's own formatter.

enabled.description: Run this Hook. The default comes from the Preset.

command.description: Format every edited file with this command instead of detecting a formatter, e.g. ["black", "--quiet", "{file}"]. Run without a shell from the project directory; `{file}` is replaced by the edited file's absolute path, which is appended when absent. On Windows name an executable (.exe), not a .cmd/.bat shim.

timeoutMs.description: Give up on the formatter after this many milliseconds, leaving the file as it is.

git-guard.description: Blocks git commands that rewrite shared history or destroy uncommitted work.

enabled.description: Run this Hook. The default comes from the Preset.
